File: The Integrated Logic Analyzer (ILA) core is a customizable logic analyzer core that can be used to monitor any internal signal of your design. The ILA core includes many advanced features of modern logic analyzers, including Boolean trigger equations, customizable data capture buffer depth, and optional trigger input/output ports. Because the ILA core is synchronous to the design being monitored, all design clock constraints that are applied to your design are also applied to the components inside the ILA core. Run-time interaction with this core requires the use of the Vivado logic analyzer feature.
文件: 片内逻辑分析仪（ILA）IP 核是一种可定制的逻辑分析仪，可用于监测设计中的任意内部信号。ILA IP 核提供现代逻辑分析仪的多种高级功能，包括布尔触发表达式、可配置的数据采集缓冲区深度以及可选的触发输入/输出端口。由于 ILA IP 核与被监测的设计同步，因此施加到设计的时钟约束也会施加到 ILA IP 核内部的组件。运行时与该 IP 核交互需要使用 Vivado 的逻辑分析仪功能。
